component.name: Klardrop
component.summary: Share files and clipboard with nearby devices

description.p: Klardrop is a cross-platform, AirDrop-style tool for sharing files and clipboard content with nearby devices on the same local network. Devices are discovered automatically over mDNS, and transfers run directly over a raw TCP connection — no account, no cloud, no internet required.

ul.li: Automatic discovery of nearby devices over the local network
Fast, direct file transfers with progress tracking
Works across Android, desktop, and macOS
